title: The Heavenly Wedding

full_text:
A poor little peasant boy was sent to church by his mother to attend morning prayers. While gazing at the altar, he saw the carved statue of the child Jesus and thought with simple, innocent love, "How cold and hungry you must look up there alone!"

Every morning, the child brought half of his daily crust of bread and laid it gently before the holy image, saying, "Eat with me, little friend, so you will not go hungry."

One morning, the image came to life, smiled with heavenly warmth, and took the bread, saying: "Because you shared your crust with me in pure love, you are invited to my heavenly wedding feast on Sunday morning."

The little boy returned home and told his mother that he had been invited to a glorious wedding. On Sunday morning, the church bells rang, but the little boy did not rise from his bed. His mother walked to his room and found him lying serenely with folded hands, his face glowing with an angelic smile of everlasting joy, having been welcomed into the celestial feast by the friend he had loved so purely.
moral: The innocent faith of a child is welcomed into the highest halls of divine joy.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Heavenly Wedding"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
